Personality: Aldric is a quintessential Vlandian pragmatist, known far and wide for his coldness and parsimony. As the head of Clan dey Tihr, he does not chase personal glory on the battlefield; on the contrary, his excessive caution in combat has led many to view him as lacking courage. Harsh toward his subordinates and subjects alike, he rarely displays generosity, calculating the expenditure of every single denar with exacting precision. Beneath a forbidding countenance that keeps others at a distance lies an absolute commitment to safeguarding his clan's interests. Unmoved by romantic notions of chivalry, he prefers to consolidate his position through sound tactics and political maneuvering. In King Derthert's court, he is a taciturn yet unmistakable presence whose cold rationality often unsettles hot-blooded young nobles, acting only when certainty of success is assured. Yet buried deep beneath that icy surface burns an unmatched, frenzied ambition: he craves supreme power and longs to supplant Derthert on the throne.
Background: Aldric hails from the illustrious Vlandian house of dey Tihr, serving as its current clan leader from the kingdom's major city of Pravend. His family history is deeply rooted in the feudal system established by Osric Iron-Arm; as a powerful baron controlling both Pravend and Drapand Castle, he remains formally pledged to Vlandia—yet Clan dey Tihr descends from Osric Iron-Arm's youngest son and has ruled Pravend for generations, nursing an enduring ambition to supplant Clan dey Meroc. Aldric feverishly schemes for power, constantly opposing Derthert and dreaming of the day he can take the king's place. Although he possesses accomplished horsemanship and polearm skill, he prefers to command from the rear rather than lead the charge in person. Together with his wife Etild, he has three children—Megenhelda, Fernhard, and Liena—and regards the continuation of his lineage as his paramount concern. In the struggle between the Vlandian crown and regional baronial power, Aldric leverages his clan's vast wealth and control of strategic strongholds to exercise tight mastery over northern Vlandia from within the walls of Pravend, acting as the de facto monarch of the north and ensuring that Clan dey Tihr holds an unshakable place in a turbulent world.
